title: Three Springs and One Short Plan
subtitle: 努力坚持 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）
meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：initiative　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 initiative 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1995 the secretary ① launched the initiative that no member in the club would have recorded, and he said the launching was the whole of the term. The ② initiative, meaning the scheme itself and not the plan, ran three terms and stayed unrecorded in the book; a initiative, he said, is the only thing in a club that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ initiative in that club had the same short plan beside it, and the ④ initiative at the far door, meaning the idea they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A initiative, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the secretary said the recording is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the initiative was the whole of the matter, meaning the action and not the scheme. The ⑥ initiative, meaning the action and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; initiative, he said, is either something you launch or the only word that means both a scheme and a action. He said the action is the part they remember.

By 2000 the ⑦ initiative had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short plan. The ⑧ initiative of the whole thing, the secretary wrote in May, was one club and three terms of recording; initiative, he said, is either the idea at the far door or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ initiative I remember is the scheme recorded in the file, which closed in 2002 and is still recorded as the quietest in the club. A ⑩ initiative, my mother said in 2004, is the only scheme that improves by being recorded; every initiative, she said, is a action that has agreed to look like a scheme. She said the action was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 倡议；主动性（指活动室里每一项旁边的那一项）
B. n. 倡议；主动性（指那项方案本身，与计划书相对）
C. 固定搭配：launch the initiative 发起这项倡议
D. n. 倡议；主动性（指留给孩子们学着提的那一条那一项）
E. n. 开创之事（抽象总称，指一处活动室的倡议之事）
F. n. 倡议；主动性（指档案里写到、被记下的的那一项）
G. n. 行动、作为（指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 作为（抽象总称，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: launched the initiative that no member in the club would have recorded
The initiative, meaning the scheme itself and not the plan
the initiative at the far door
the initiative was the whole of the matter
the initiative had become a line in a file
The initiative of the whole thing
A initiative, my mother said in 2004

answers.why: launch the initiative 意为“发起这项倡议”，1995 年那位干事把活动室里没有一位成员肯记录的一项倡议做了一遍。
initiative 意为“倡议；主动性”，指那项方案本身而不是计划书，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记录。
initiative 意为“倡议；主动性”，指活动室里每一项旁边的那一项，每一项旁边都有同一份薄薄的计划书。
initiative 意为“倡议；主动性”，指最远那个门口留给孩子们学着提的那一条那一项，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
initiative 意为“行动、作为”，指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这次行动就是那件事的全部。
initiative 意为“作为”，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西而不是那项方案，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
initiative 意为“倡议；主动性”，指档案里写到、被记下的的那一项，到 2000 年这一项成了档案里的一行。
initiative 意为“开创之事”，干事五月写道，整件事的倡议之事是一处活动室和三个学期的记录。
initiative 意为“倡议；主动性”，我记得的是档案里记录过的那一项，2002 年落地了，至今仍被说成活动室里最安静的一项。
initiative 为抽象总称，母亲 2004 年说，倡议是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的方案。
